## Analysis of Public Transport Observations

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

logged_data <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTGzvxSKzI0bMIpnofOget2sOOiLVsmXXl5lZgbCBhONKjjPNXnhaq6biI7dJchORSju2JPfl1vzklB/pub?output=csv"

latest_data <- read_csv(logged_data)

latest_data_renamed <- latest_data %>%
  rename(
    public_transport = 2,
    day_type = 3,
    day_time = 4,
    crowd_level = 5,
    minutes_late = 6,
    additional_comments = 7,
    waiting_time = 8
  )

# The minimum minutes_late
min(latest_data_renamed$minutes_late)

# The maximum waiting time
max(latest_data_renamed$waiting_time)

# The average waiting_time for Public Transport

mean(latest_data_renamed$waiting_time)

ggplot(latest_data_renamed, aes(x = public_transport, fill = public_transport)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Bus" = "red",
    "Train" = "blue",
    "Ferry" = "yellow",
    "Taxi" = "green"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Transport Type Distribution",
    x = "Transport Type",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


ggplot(latest_data_renamed, aes(x = crowd_level, fill = crowd_level)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Empty" = "lavender",
    "Moderate" = "plum",
    "Crowded" = "orchid",
    "Very Crowded" = "purple4"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Crowd Levels on Public Transport",
    x = "Crowd Level",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Crowding"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

  
```
